messages.subject: ggplot2 feature request: hyperlinks
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to see hyperlink capbility in ggplots, for backend which
support it, such as html impagemap, svg and pdf.

geom_point, geom_text and scale(link=c())

I should be able to add attributes to points, bars, and scales that
add hyperlinks (via a format function) that enable hyperlinks.

-Alex

messages.author: c55591d2e988ddca
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 feature request: hyperlinks
parts:
On 04/11/2012 03:43 PM, Hadley Wickham wrote:
> I'd be willing to consider this, but it really needs to be well
> thought out. Could you please provide a few examples?

I'm not certain what example flavors you'd find useful, so I'll show you
mine at a coarse level, and will happily refine to something that could
go in an issue entry if it's close.

I've been building imagemaps through R as a way to explore and
understand the behavior of my backup server since ca. 2005, at least.

http://open-systems.ufl.edu/tsm/graphs/ALL.html

The process is clumsy, and as I look at it today, even more awkward than
I was grumbling about as I wrote it. When you start naming data objects
'mess' and 'mess2', ...

what I had to do then was build my "stacked bar chart" by hand,
individually calculating each point. I did this because I needed the
same set of points to construct a polygon in an accompanying "imagemap"
object.

[ digression: Yes, I know stacked bar charts are rubbish. Sorry, Mr.
Tufte. ]

So what I'd like out of ggplot is a way I could assign an attribute to a
series, analogous to color or linestyle, which is 'uri'. PDF and SVG
output ought to have the URI associated with things relating to that
series by default: this would include legend entries and "unambiguous"
regions in the graph.

Whee, defining unambiguous sounds miserable. I'm not sure that it could
be done for point and line graphs beyond a certain density, and maybe
that's a relevant knob. There are certainly some of my graphs in which
selecting a given series is ridiculous.

http://open-systems.ufl.edu/tsm/graphs/erp/ERP.html

For imagemap usage, I envision printing out the ggplot2 object twice:
Once to generate a bitmap-based image, and another time to generate the
corresponding imagemap description. I'd have to specify their size
identically, of course, or everything would be wrong.

- Allen S. Rout
